claim_and_decision.target_user_and_scenario: The project owner deciding the next maintainable implementation unit after persistence and provider-receipt work.
claim_and_decision.decision_driven: Use the result only to select or reject one bounded engineering next step; do not execute the recommendation automatically.

Credentials, cookies, tokens or other projects
Claim of user productivity or multi-Bot superiority
